widening the garage door opening. installin two simpsom steel strong wallsin first story.

voluntary structural upgrade of garage level. demo of existing garage level ceiling & replace with 1 hr. rated floor/ceiling assembly on north side of garage. increase project valuation per inspector dennis carlin by $100,000.

rev. to previous permit #2007/01/26/2675, remove posts and beams at garage, remove second floor bearing wall, revise third floor framing. install new steel posts & beamss & foundation for removed structure.
new interior layout & 1/2 bath on 3/f. demo & replace 2/f kitchen & bath, repair doors, windows & finishes, 2 new skylights.
